description: C01 Part II, clock control, ADDED AFTER an interim look at 46 of 80 C01-PARTE2-FASE1 runs showed MLP-wide (width + clock) close to the LSTM; it is therefore exploratory, not preregistered with the main family. One arm: MLP-wide without the episode clock (11,401 parameters), on the same first 10 seeds as C01-PARTE2-FASE1 (same seed rule and exclusions), 300k interactions, re-evaluated 3 times. Learning rate fixed at 0.001, the rate the preregistered search chose for MLP-wide with clock; no new search.
